THE DIRECTION AHEAD

Keep the history.
Build the next chapter.

Our direction brings preservation, education, dealer development, and international expansion together.

01 / THE NEXT CHAPTER

Preserve the record

Gather dated articles, photographs, dealer materials, and firsthand accounts. Keep verified evidence distinct from open research.

02 / THE NEXT CHAPTER

Share calling education

Connect hunters and retailer teams with demonstrations, model-specific care, and the knowledge behind the calls.

03 / THE NEXT CHAPTER

Develop dealer relationships

Build conversations with retailers, distributors, guides, and educators. Confirm commercial arrangements directly and in writing.

04 / THE NEXT CHAPTER

Carry the story forward

Connect the Montana origin with future generations and the countries and regions named in the legacy story.
